title: Prize or giveaway claim
summary: A message says you won and asks for a fee, code, or identity information.
scenario: The prize cannot be collected until you pay, click, or disclose sensitive data.
warning_signs: You did not enter the promotion
safe_actions: Do not pay to claim an unexpected prize
Verify the promotion using a known organizer channel
Do not open supplied links or share secrets
recovery_guidance: Contact the payment provider if money was sent
Secure accounts and keep the claim message
reporting_guidance: Preserve the promotion and transaction details
Use a reporting destination after checking it independently
prevention_tips: Winning is not proof that the sender is genuine
Treat guaranteed rewards as unverified until checked
false_positive_notes: Real promotions exist, but they should be traceable without an advance payment or secret.
